column1: # rabble_beam_console(type, text, fields, ...). Run in ORDER inside ONE fresh process: the sequence counter starts at 1 and every emitted line consumes one number, so row order matters.
# fields: "-" means the fields argument is NULL; a number N means the fields format is the 9-byte member text "bytes":%u (with the quote characters, no spaces) given the unsigned value N.
# text: @null = NULL pointer, @empty = empty string, otherwise hex of the bytes.
# columns: note, text, type, fields, output_hex (everything written to stdout by the call, all lines), shown_output (newlines shown as \n)
type with text null and fields
